request.instructions:

5. Be concise. Use short paragraphs or bullet lists. Do not repeat the question.

tools.description: Find people, organizations, projects and meetings by name, and passages in the user's transcripts and notes that match the query. Use this first when you do not yet have a reference.
tools.name: search

query.description: What to look for: a name, a topic or a phrase. 1–200 characters.

scope.description: Which results matter most: "entities" (names), "documents" (passages) or "all" (default). Both kinds are always searched; the other kind is just shortened.

tools.description: Get one entity's type, name, aliases, attributes and counts.
tools.name: get_entity

entity.description: An entity reference (entN) from an earlier tool result.

tools.description: List what an entity is connected to, optionally as of a past date.
tools.name: neighbors

asOf.description: Evaluate the graph as of this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

hops.description: How far to walk: 1 (direct connections, default) or 2.

relationTypes.description: Walk only these relation types, e.g. ["WORKS_FOR", "REPORTS_TO"]. Default: all.

types.description: Keep only these node types, e.g. ["Person", "Organization"] or item kinds ["commitment", "decision"]. Default: all.

tools.description: List dated events about an entity (decisions, commitments, claims, role and employer changes, meetings), newest first.
tools.name: timeline

asOf.description: Only events up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

kinds.description: Keep only these event kinds: commitment, decision, claim, person_fact, risk, relation, meeting. Default: all.

tools.description: Get the source quotes that support an entity, item or relation. Cite these with [^evN].
tools.name: evidence

subject.description: An entity (entN), item (itmN) or relation (relN) reference.

tools.description: Get a cited summary of what is new about an entity: what changed, decisions, open commitments, risks and claims, people changes.
tools.name: entity_brief

asOf.description: Evaluate the brief as of this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today. With it, no stored summary is returned.

since.description: Start of the "what changed" window (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the last 30 days or the last summary.

tools.description: List commitments, optionally for one person or organization, by status and due date.

direction.description: With entity: "owned_by" (they promised it), "owed_to" (it was promised to them) or "any" (default).

dueBefore.description: Only commitments due on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.description: List risks, issues and blockers, optionally for one project, product, organization or person, by status and severity. Highest severity first.

severity.description: Only risks of this severity. Default: any severity.
